newsitem.title: USA: Montana coal units cut power for repairs.
newsitem.headline: Montana coal units cut power for repairs.

text.p: Montana Power Co will reduce power output from its Colstrip coal-fired power station in Colstrip, Mont. through the weekend, a company spokesman said Friday.
The 320 megawatt Colstrip unit 2 was expected to return to service on Saturday after being taken off line Thursday to repair a boiler tube leak, said company spokesman Cort Freeman.
Montana Power will also shut the 700 megawatt Colstrip unit 4 at about 0100 MST (0300 EST) on Saturday for repairs, Freeman said.
Unit 4 is expected to be out of service for about 36 hours, he said.
Freeman would not comment on whether Montana Power would have to purchase electricity on the open market to make up for the outages.
